title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
The BE MORE Group is a five-person real estate team serving relocators moving to Florida’s Emerald Coast — Pensacola through Fort Walton Beach. Our YouTube channel is our primary lead generation engine, targeting families, veterans, and professionals making long-distance moves to the area. It is ran by two of the agents on the team, Caleb D and Aaron H.



On our channel, we publish long-form educational videos that are data-heavy and conversational. Our audience comes to us for honest local expertise, and our content reflects that. We have a defined brand voice and visual style that this role is expected to match exactly.

 

What You’ll Be Doing



This is a content management role, not just a clipping job. You’ll own four interconnected pipelines — long-form video production, short-form distribution, AI-assisted content operations, and multi-platform social publishing. A typical week spans all four, a typical day three out of four mostly.

 

Long-Form Video Production

•     Publish finished videos to YouTube with fully optimized metadata: titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, and thumbnails

•     Track video performance in YouTube Studio and report key metrics (views, watch time, CTR, subscriber impact) on a weekly basis

•.    Our videos are edited by a third party who will provide the completed video and thumnail. We post every four days. You will not be required to edit long form content.

 

Short-Form Content (YouTube Shorts, Reels)

•     Identify and cut the highest-value clips from long-form YouTube videos for distribution as Shorts and Reels.

•     Apply SEO best practices to every short: hooks, captions, hashtags, and platform-specific formatting

•     Schedule and publish across YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels

•     Monitor short-form performance metrics and flag what’s working for content strategy discussions

•.    Cut and Edit 5-7 raw short form videos for Instagram Reels every week. This will be a preponderance of your duties. We          

       have the content machine already built--we record, we drop in a folder, you edit according to our brand guide, you post.

 

AI Content Operations (Claude AI)

•     Manage and operate our Claude AI content workflow — we call it our Content Machine — to generate written content from video scripts and research

•     Convert AI-generated output into polished, publish-ready blog posts formatted for our Google Business Profile pages

•     Maintain consistency between written blog content and the corresponding video — same data, same voice, same accuracy standards

•      Post Polished AI Content across 3-5 Google My Business Pages (Depending on which content). 

 

Multi-Platform Social Media Management

•     Manage content publishing and scheduling across LinkedIn,
, Instagram, YouTube, and Google My Business

•     Adapt content format and copy for each platform — what works on YouTube doesn’t always land the same on LinkedIn or other platforms.

•     Maintain the content calendar and upload tracker in Google Sheets. Provide weekly updates on specific data metrics.

What We’re Looking For

title: Long-Term Short-Form Video Editor — Fitness Creator (500K+ following) — Start ASAP, 8-Week Europe Project + Ongoing
description:
Hi! I’m a fitness content creator with 521,000 followers across Instagram and TikTok. I’m hiring a dedicated short-form video editor for a long-term role starting in the next 2 weeks.

THIS IS A LONG-TERM POSITION — not a one-off project. I’m looking for someone to work with me for at least 12 months, ideally years.



ABOUT THE WORK:

You will edit 8–12 short-form Reels and TikToks per week from raw iPhone footage I film at the gym. The style I need is fast-cut, native-feeling, trending-audio-driven — the kind of edit that looks like I made it myself on CapCut. Cinematic editing is NOT what I need (I have another editor for that). I need snappy, energetic, scroll-stopping cuts.



WHY THE TIMING MATTERS:

I’m travelling to Europe in approximately 4 weeks for an 8-week content trip. I will be filming across multiple European cities. I need you fully trained and producing at full capacity BEFORE I leave, so the content keeps flowing while I’m travelling. While I’m in Europe, our workflow will be: I film and upload during the European day, you edit overnight Philippine time, I wake up to finished edits in the morning Europe time, I approve and post.

THIS IS A REAL OPPORTUNITY. The Europe trip is a major growth push for my account. Whoever I hire will be a core part of that growth.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EACH WEEK:

• Receive a Google Drive folder of raw iPhone footage each day

• Edit 1–2 short-form videos per day (vertical 9:16, 15–45 seconds each)

• Sync trending audio (you stay on top of what’s hitting on TikTok)

• Add burned-in captions in a clean style

• Suggest a caption (1 sentence) for each Reel

• Deliver finished cuts within 24 hours of receiving footage

• Communicate via WhatsApp daily

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU:

• Strong portfolio of short-form work — even if it’s not fitness, I want to see your sense of pacing

• Experience with CapCut Pro (preferred) or Premiere Pro

• Fast turnaround — under 24 hours from footage to edit

• Available to work overnight Philippine time during my Europe trip (this aligns with European daytime)

• Reliable internet for uploading/downloading large video files

• Long-term commitment — minimum 12 months



WHAT I OFFER:

• $300–400 USD per month for part-time work (~15–20 hours/week)

• Weekly payment via Wise on Fridays

• 90-day probation period — if it works, your rate increases to $400–500/month

• 13th-month bonus around Christmas (yes, even though you’re a contractor)

• Long-term stability — I want to build a relationship, not churn through editors

• Clear feedback, written briefs, no chaos



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR:

You don’t need to be a fitness expert. You don’t need to have edited for big creators before. What I need is:

• Eye for pacing — you instinctively know when a cut should land

• Energy and curiosity for what’s trending on TikTok right now

• Reliability — when you say 24 hours, you mean 24 hours

• Hunger to grow with a creator who’s growing fast



HOW TO APPLY:

Send me a message that includes these 4 things, in this order:

 1. Your name and where in the Philippines you live

 2. 2–3 links to your best short-form edits (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio site — NOT just a CV)

 3. Answer this in 2 sentences: “What’s one TikTok trend you’ve seen in the last 7 days that I should be using for fitness content?”

 4. Confirm: are you available to work during European daytime hours (3pm–11pm Philippine time) for 8 weeks starting in approximately 5 weeks?

I will only read applications that include all 4 things. Generic CVs and template cover letters will not be reviewed. The 4 items above are the only application I need.

Looking forward to finding the right person for a long-term role.
salary: 300-400 USD a month grow to 400-500 USD

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — The Steadfast Athlete (YouTube)



About the Channel

The Steadfast Athlete is a YouTube channel about steadfast self-leadership through physical, mental, and spiritual discipline. The content is personal, documentary-style, faith-forward storytelling — not flashy fitness content or gym vlogs. Think more like a mini-documentary than an influencer video. The brand feel is dark, warm, earthy, and weathered — gritty and real, not polished or corporate.

I film on a smartphone and provide detailed edit blueprints for each video that lay out the story structure, music mood, pacing, and overall direction. I'm looking for an editor who can follow that direction while bringing their own creative instincts to the work. I want to see your interpretation of the blueprint, not a robotic execution of it.



What You'll Be Editing

1 long-form YouTube video every 2 weeks (8–15 minutes, documentary-style talking head + B-roll)

Optional: Short-form clips (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok) cut from the long-form video — this is an add-on, not required from day one



What I Provide You (via Google Drive)

Raw footage — talking head and personal B-roll I've filmed

A detailed edit blueprint for each video — story structure, section-by-section instructions, music mood map, and pacing guidance

A brand package — color palette, font information, and a full set of pre-made graphics (title cards, lower thirds, end cards) as PNG files



What I Need From You

Strong Adobe Premiere Pro skills — comfortable with Lumetri color grading, keyframing, audio mixing, J-cuts/L-cuts, speed ramping, and adjustment layers

An understanding of documentary-style pacing — knowing when to let a moment breathe vs. when to tighten the edit

Music selection — I provide mood direction and search terms in each blueprint. You find and select the right tracks. The brand standard for music is Artlist. For stock footage, the brand standard is Artgrid.

Audio mixing skills — dialogue cleanup, music balancing, room tone layering

Reliability and clear communication via



How B-Roll Works

I provide my own personal B-roll footage for each video. This should be your primary visual material — the authenticity of personal footage is important to this brand. Build the edit around what I give you.

If there's a moment where you feel additional stock footage would genuinely improve the video, you're expected to find it and include it. The brand standard for stock footage is Artgrid. If you need to use alternative sources, keep it consistent with the brand feel: dark, warm, earthy, authentic — not polished stock-photo energy.



How Music Works

Each edit blueprint includes a music mood map with the emotional direction for every section of the video — what it should feel like, when to build, when to drop to silence, and suggested search terms. You're responsible for finding and selecting the tracks. The brand standard for music is Artlist.



Bonus (Not Required)

Experience editing faith-based, personal development, or documentary content

Ability to cut YouTube Shorts, Reels, and TikToks from long-form footage

Thumbnail design skills

Color grading experience beyond basic Lumetri



Schedule and Commitment

Long-form only:

5–8 hours per week

Delivery: 1 edited video every 2 weeks



Long-form + short-form:

8–12 hours per week

Delivery: 1 edited video + 2–3 short-form clips every 2 weeks



Communication:

File sharing: Google Drive

Timezone: Flexible — I care about quality and deadlines, not when you're online



Compensation

$3 USD/hour. I want to be upfront — I'm in the early stages of building this channel and working within a tight budget. What I'm looking for is someone who sees this as a relationship we're building together. I take this work seriously, I'll provide thorough direction for every video, and I'm committed to making this a good working partnership for both of us.



How to Apply

Send me:

A link to 2–3 videos you've edited that show your pacing and storytelling ability (YouTube links preferred)

A brief note about what kind of content you enjoy editing and why this role interests you

Your weekly availability



I'll send the top candidates a short test edit using real footage and an edit blueprint so I can see how you interpret direction while bringing your own creative instincts.

title: Brand Content Designer— Pet Lifestyle Brands (Canva + Notion, $550/mo, Work On Your Own Time)
description:
We're a multi-brand pet lifestyle business in the US (Chic Kitty, Shaggy Chic, Hugo the Minskin, and ambassador brands). We're hiring a Brand Content Producer to compile our weekly content across four brand identities.



You'll never touch our social media platforms or post anything live. You are the COMPILER. Our Operations Manager (OBM) provides you with the weekly content calendar, including exact specs. Our editor delivers video clips. Our graphic designer builds the master Canva templates. You pull the right pieces together, drop them into templates, package each piece according to our Notion naming conventions, and hand them off to the OBM for approval.



The work is precise, repeatable, and high-volume. If you love systems, follow strict guidelines exactly, and take pride in clean handoffs — this is your role.



WORK ON YOUR OWN TIME



This is a results-based role. We don't track when you work — we track what you deliver and whether it's on time, every time.



If you're a student, knock it out on your day off. If you have another job, do a little each day. If you're a night owl, work overnight. We don't care when the hours happen as long as:



- Weekly deliverables are complete on schedule (we give you the calendar a week in advance)

- The work is consistently on-brand and on-spec



Roughly 20 hours of work per week. Could be five 4-hour blocks. Could be two 10-hour sprints. Your call.



RESPONSE TIME



You'll work directly with our OBM (also Philippines-based, in the same time zone). Respond to OB
ssages in a timely manner — never longer than 12 hours on business days. Quick communication keeps the team's calendar moving.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Every week, the OBM gives you a content calendar with exact specs for each piece. Your job is to:



- Assemble carousels in Canva using designer-built templates (3-5 per brand per week)

- Build Story sets with a minimum of 3-7 photos per set (templates pre-built by designer; you fill, label, and package)

- Convert Reels into Pinterest video pins (no re-editing, just package and label)

- Convert blog content into Pinterest idea pins (5-10 pages each)

- Convert blogs into Instagram carousels (each slide a stand-alone reference card)

- Cross-format content for different platforms (one piece often becomes 5-9 derivatives)

- Pull video clips from our raw footage Drive folder per the weekly specs

- Curate UGC and photo banks — sort approved submissions into the right brand folders

- Package each finished piece in Notion with strict naming conventions (we'll train you)

- Hand off to OBM for approval through Notion + WhatsApp

- Use our content banks and per-platform checklists each week

- Follow the weekly calendar exactly — no improvisation, no scope creep



PLATFORMS YOU'LL WORK IN



- Canva Pro (we provide access)

- Notion (we provide access — our Notion Architect will train you on our system)

- Google Drive (we provide access)



You will NOT log into any of our brand social media accounts (Instagram,
, Pinterest, TikTok). All posting is handled by a separate team.



WHAT YOU WON'T DO



- D
 what content gets made (OBM owns the calendar)

- Write captions, hashtags, or first-comments (OBM owns those banks)

- Edit video (editor owns that)

- Design templates from scratch (graphic designer builds masters; you swap content into them)

- Post anything to any platform (engagement team does posting)

- Engage with audience (engagement team does that)



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong Canva Pro skills — must be an expert with smart frames, hide/show toggles, brand template systems

- Fluent English (written) — must communicate clearly with US-based owner and Filipino OBM

- Strong eye for visual consistency — when given five brand systems with five distinct palettes, you respect each one and never mix them

- Detail discipline — naming conventions, folder structure, version control all matter

- Notion experience preferred (we'll train if not, but you must learn fast)

- Reliable internet

- Self-disciplined — flexibility only works if you deliver every time



OUR BRAND DNA — STRICT GUIDELINES YOU FOLLOW



We are a 100% AI-free brand. We do not use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, or any AI tool to create or assemble content. Every image and video is human-sourced and human-assembled. This is a firm policy — confirm in your application that you can work without AI tools.



We treat our animals like people. Never "the cat" or "the dog" — always by name (Hugo, Selina) or pronoun (she, he). Voice rule is locked across every brand.



Type lives in panels, never overlays photos. The animal is always 70-80% of the frame. Restraint signals confidence (our reference brands are The Row, Aesop, Kinfolk, Jacquemus, Bottega Veneta).



COMPENSATION



- $550 USD / month flat

- Roughly 20 hours / week (your schedule, your pacing)

- Paid biweekly via Wise, Remitly, or PayPal (your choice)

- Long-term role with growth potential as our brand portfolio expands



APPLICATION — REQUIRED



Please include:

1. Brief intro (3-5 sentences) — who you are, where you're based, your work setup, what else is on your plate (school, another job, etc. — that's fine, we want to know)

2. Link to portfolio or 3 examples of brand-template assembly work you've done (Canva carousels, social media graphics, brand kits)

3. Confirmation that you currently work AI-free, or that you commit to working AI-free in this role

4. Have you used Notion before? Brief description of how

5. Tell us how you'd structure roughly 20 hours per week across a real week of your life

6. Your favorite reference brand from this list: The Row, Aesop, Kinfolk, Jacquemus, Bottega Veneta — and one sentence on why



We respond to qualified applicants within 7 days. Top candidates receive a paid test ($40 USD) before the final hiring decision.

title: AI Developer
description:
We're looking for an AI-first developer who genuinely loves building and shows up with the plan. If you light up when you talk about wiring agents together, shipping internal tools fast, and using AI as a daily working partner, and you'd rather drive the build strategy than wait for a spec, we'd love to hear from you.



The Role



This is a gig-based, project-driven build role focused on internal tooling. Here's what you'd actually be doing:



- Building agents and automations from the ground up, including wiring up MCP servers and Claude Code workflows

- Building a range of internal tools for the team, the kind of things that remove manual work and speed up how we operate

- Working across APIs and integrations, including GoHighLevel, to connect the systems we run on

- Partnering with the team on what gets built and why. We work as a team to win, and you'd own the technical thinking on your side of it



Within the first 30 to 60 days, success looks like you showing up with the plan. You should be telling us what we should build next, how to approach it, and in what order. You should have a clear point of view on what's worth automating, what isn't, and what you want to ship first. The bar here is strategic ownership of the build, not waiting for a backlog to be handed to you.



Schedule



Work hours are flexible but need to overlap with our team between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST during active project work. Just want to make sure you can meet inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before shipping anything.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be building, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort with Claude Code, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, working with APIs, and the GoHighLevel API. We're also genuinely interested in whatever else you've built your workflow around.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need:

   - Claude Code    /10

   - GitHub    /10

   - Supabase    /10

   - Vercel    /10

   - Working with APIs    /10

   - GoHighLevel API    /10



   Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with /10. Include AI tools, frameworks, automation platforms, niche services, spreadsheets you've built, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts:

   - What size was the company or account when you started (team size, what they were running, what was manual before you came in, whatever metric fits)?

   - What did you build for them?

   - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

   - If you have current clients, where are those projects today?



   We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better:



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a build task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you came on next week and we asked you to build out our internal tooling, walk us through your first 30 days. What would you want to look at, what would you build first, and how would you d
 the order?

2. We hand you a vague request like "we need something to make X less painful," with no spec. Walk us through how you go from that sentence to a shipped tool.

3. An automation you built has started silently failing in production. Walk us through what you check first and how you track it down.

4. Why do you love building this kind of thing? Tell us about a recent tool or automation you shipped that reminded you why you do this work.

5. What's something about building with Claude Code, MCP, or agentic workflows that's changed in the last year that you've actually adjusted your approach around?

title: Video Editor and Strategist
description:
We're looking for an AI-first video editor and social media strategist who genuinely loves short-form content and shows up with the plan. If you study what's working on each platform, use AI as a daily working partner, and would rather tell us what to make than wait for a shot list, we'd love to hear from you. This role is mainly for Evident Elements, a clean electrolyte brand.



The Role



You'll find and analyze videos across platforms, spot what's performing and why, and give clear direction on what we should be making next. You're not just editing what you're handed. You're d
 what gets made.



You'll edit short-form video knowing what actually performs per platform. A cut that wins on TikTok is not the same cut that wins on Reels or Shorts, and you understand those differences in your bones.



You'll partner with our team to turn that direction into a steady output of content that moves the brand forward. We work as a team to win, and you lead the thinking on your part of it.



What success looks like in the first 30 to 60 days: you're showing up with a point of view. You can tell us what's working, what isn't, and what you want to test next. You've spotted patterns in our content and competitors' content that we hadn't, and you're driving the content direction rather than waiting on a brief. The bar is strategic ownership, not task completion.



Schedule



You'll work part-time hours that fall somewhere between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST. We'll set the exact schedule together. Just want to make sure you can work somewhere inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before sending anything off.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be making, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Platform fluency. You know what does well on TikTok versus Reels versus Shorts, and you can explain why, not just guess.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). List every tool you use in your work, one per line, with a /10 rating. Include editing tools, AI tools, scripting and research tools, content calendar systems, anything you've built around your workflow. We're more interested in what you've built around your work than the big-name platforms. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts:



- What size was the account or channel when you started (followers, views, post volume, whatever metric fits)?

- What did you do for them?

- What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

- If you have current clients, where are those accounts today?



We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better:



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you joined next week, walk me through how you'd figure out what content we should be making. What would you look at, and what would your first hypothesis to test be?

2. Walk me through how you find and analyze videos to d
 what's worth modeling. What signals tell you a video is actually working versus just got lucky?

3. A short-form video gets strong views but almost no profile visits or saves. How do you diagnose that, and what do you change?

4. Why do you love this work? Tell me about a recent video or 
nt that reminded you why you do it.

5. What's something about short-form right now, on a platform you know well, that most editors are getting wrong or haven't caught up to yet?

title: Job Title: E-commerce Operations Controller (Freight, Inventory & Cost)
description:
PLEASE READ THIS JOB DESCRIPTION CAREFULLY



Who We Are



Southshore Fine Linens is a fast-growing home textiles brand operating 3,500+ SKUs across DTC, marketplaces, and wholesale channels, supported by a 68,000 sq ft distribution center and an in-house logistics operation.



We move a lot of product.

We spend a lot on freight.

We carry a lot of inventory.



We are looking for the person who can see where the money leaks — and close it.



The Mission of This Role



Your job is simple to describe and difficult to execute:



Treat our costs, freight, and inventory like a live control panel.



You will monitor, analyze, and optimize:



Shipping & carrier costs



3PL and warehouse expenses



Inventory levels and aging



SKU velocity and reorder timing



Storage fees and fulfillment fees



Landed cost per SKU



Cash tied up in inventory



Operational accuracy of our books vs reality



You are the person who asks every week:



“Why did this cost go up?”

“Why is this SKU still sitting?”

“Where are we leaking money?”



What You Will Own

???? Freight & Shipping Cost Control



Audit UPS, FedEx, LTL, and container freight invoices



Track cost per shipment, per SKU, per channel



Identify trends, billing errors, and optimization opportunities



Work with carriers to reduce rates and improve terms



Build weekly and monthly freight cost dashboards



???? Inventory Intelligence



Monitor inventory aging and turnover



Identify slow-moving and dead SKUs



Forecast reorder quantities based on velocity



Reduce over-ordering and stockouts



Track storage fees (FBA / warehouse) tied to poor inventory planning



???? Cost & Margin Visibility



Calculate true landed cost per SKU (product + freight + storage + handling)



Show margin after shipping and fulfillment costs



Highlight SKUs that look profitable but are not



Help leadership make smarter purchasing decisions



???? Books & Operational Reality



Reconcile operational data with QuickBooks / accounting reports



Ensure COGS, inventory value, and expenses reflect reality



Build clean reporting that ties operations to financials



???? Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:



Freight cost tracker



Inventory aging dashboard



SKU velocity report



Reorder model



Margin by SKU after logistics cost



Who You Are



You are not a traditional bookkeeper.



You are:



Extremely comfortable in Excel / Google Sheets



Naturally analytical and detail-obsessed



Experienced with inventory, logistics, or supply chain numbers



Someone who enjoys finding inefficiencies



Curious about why numbers change



Comfortable working with warehouse and logistics teams



The type of person who gets satisfaction from saving a company $5,000/month



Required Experience



3+ years in operations, inventory, logistics, or cost analysis



Strong spreadsheet skills (advanced formulas, pivots, modeling)



Experience analyzing freight / shipping / inventory data



Experience working with QuickBooks or similar accounting software



Experience in e-commerce, retail, or product-based business preferred



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)



Clear visibility into all freight and shipping costs



Identified cost leaks and implemented savings



Clean inventory aging and velocity reports



Reorder model in place



Leadership can see true margin per SKU



Why This Role Matters



This is a high-impact role.

The right person in this seat will pay for themselves many times over by reducing costs and improving inventory decisions.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note explaining a time you found a cost inefficiency and how you fixed it.



Work hours:

MONDAY THRU FRIDAY - Pacific Standard Time.

description:

Work from (almost) anywhere: Once you’re through our 1-month onboarding at our office, your favorite SG cafe or your home setup is your workplace.

25 social media posts (mix of reels and static) per month

3 - 5 Static display panels

Simple graphic design like stand up banners, event backdrops; mostly adaptions and simple layouts



Your AI Sidekicks (Let’s Learn Together)

We’re big believers in working smarter, not harder. We’re constantly experimenting with AI to see how it can make our "Fast to Finish" workflow even faster. You don’t need to be an expert in all of these right now, but we’re looking for someone with the curiosity to dive in and learn as we go.

Adobe Firefly & Generative Fill: (Already in your Creative Cloud!) Great for fixing backgrounds in a snap.



Visual Inspo: We’ll play with tools like Midjourney or DALL-E to storyboard ideas before we even hit the "record" button.

Are you "The One"?

AE is your bestie: You’re fluent in After Effects and the Adobe Suite. You don’t just "use" the software; you make it sing.



Trend Obsessed: You know what’s trending on TikTok/IG before it even hits the "For You" page. You have a "One-Shot" eye for what’s fashionable and clean.



Low Ego, High Output: You’re self-motivated, detail-oriented, and can take a joke..



Experience: You’ve got at least 1 year in a creative agency (or high-level freelance) and a portfolio that proves you can translate vibes into technical tasks.

If you’re looking for a role that’s fast to finish but professional by design, hit us up. We don't do boring, and we don't do complex. Let’s make something iconic.



Send us your reel (and maybe your favorite AI-generated piece) and let’s chat!

title: Motion Graphics
description:
Motion Graphics & Animation Creator

Remote | Full-Time | Global

About the Role

We are a manpower agency recruiting on behalf of a high-output digital content client. We are looking for 6 talented Motion Graphics & Animation Creators to join a fully remote, collaborative production team. This team produces visually compelling, high-quality video content covering defense and military topics — including fighter jets, naval vessels, missile defense systems, armored vehicles, and modern warfare technology.

This is a fast-paced, creatively demanding role suited for individuals who thrive under structured timelines, take pride in exceptional craft, and are comfortable working within a team-based production pipeline.



What You'll Be Doing

Each week, the team collectively receives the following from the client every Sunday:

•Long-form and short-form scripts

•Voice-over audio

•Shot lists

•Research materials



The team is expected to deliver by Thursday:

•No less than 1 long-form video averaging ~10 minutes in length

•No less than 5 short-form reels of approximately 60 seconds each



You will be responsible for the full production cycle — motion graphics creation, 3D animation, AI-assisted video generation, audio syncing, and final assembly — working collaboratively with fellow creators and reporting directly to one team manager.



What We're Looking For



You must be genuinely advanced in your craft. The timelines are tight, the quality bar is high, and the content demands precision, creativity, and technical depth.



Motion Graphics & Animation

•Adobe After Effects (compositing, motion design, visual effects)

•Blender (3D modeling, animation, geometry nodes, EEVEE/Cycles rendering)

•Cinema 4D with Redshift (procedural animation, MoGraph toolset)

•DaVinci Resolve / Blackmagic Fusion (compositing, color grading, editing)

•Adobe Premiere Pro (editing and final output assembly)



AI Video Generation

•Kling 3.0

•Google Veo / Google Flow

•Runway Gen-4

•Luma Ray 3.1

•Seedance

•Minimax / Hailuo

•Pika (for short-form creative clips)



What Makes You Stand Out

•You can produce cinematic, visually rich content around technical subject matter (military, defense, aerospace)

•You understand shot composition, pacing, and how to pair animation with voice-over

•You are comfortable syncing audio, sound design, and music to visual sequences

•You work efficiently without sacrificing quality — hitting weekly deadlines is non-negotiable

•You collaborate well in a remote, async team environment



The Setup

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Fully Remote (global applicants welcome; candidates in cost-effective regions strongly encouraged to apply)

Deliverables: Weekly — submitted every Thursday

Goal: Build a strong content backlog while maintaining consistent weekly output



Who Should Apply

If you have spent time mastering motion graphics and animation, keep up with the latest AI video tools, produce work that genuinely stands out, and want a stable full-time remote role where your skills are put to real use every week — we want to hear from you.



To Apply:

Submit your portfolio/showreel, a brief note on your strongest tools, and your availability.

title: Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist to help manage, optimise and grow Amazon performance for consumer product brands.

This role is suited to someone who understands Amazon as more than an advertising platform. We need someone who knows how Amazon works as a marketplace, sales channel, product testing environment, brand protection tool and retail growth accelerator.

The right person will be confident working across Amazon Ads, Seller Central, Vendor Central, product listings, Amazon storefronts, Shopify connections, marketplace connectors, pricing control, product testing and campaign reporting.

This is not a basic “set up campaigns and leave them running” role. We need someone who can think strategically, commercially and technically to help brands achieve profitable growth on Amazon.



Role Overview

You will help plan, launch, manage and optimise Amazon advertising campaigns while also supporting the marketplace strategy behind those campaigns.

This includes understanding which products should be promoted on Amazon, how Amazon should work alongside Shopify or other eCommerce channels, how to avoid channel cannibalisation, and how to improve product visibility, pricing integrity and conversion performance.

The ideal candidate will be able to look at an Amazon account and identify:

Which campaigns are wasting spend

Which products have the best growth potential

Which listings need to be improved before scaling ads

Whether Vendor Central, Seller Central or a hybrid model is best suited

How Amazon can be used to test products before broader retail expansion

What return is required before increasing the ad budget



Key Responsibilities

Amazon Advertising

You will be responsible for planning, building, managing and optimising Amazon Ads campaigns, including:

Sponsored Products

Sponsored Brands

Sponsored Brands Video

Sponsored Display

Keyword targeting campaigns

Product targeting campaigns

Defensive brand campaigns

Competitor targeting campaigns

Category campaigns

Seasonal and promotional campaigns

You will manage campaign structure, keyword strategy, bids, budgets, placement performance, search terms, product targeting and ongoing optimisation.



Marketplace Strategy

You will help shape Amazon growth strategies that support each brand’s wider sales and eCommerce model.

This may include advising on:

Amazon vs Shopify product separation

Product testing strategies

Channel segmentation

Retail, Amazon and direct-to-consumer product allocation

Seller Central vs Vendor Central suitability

Hybrid marketplace models

Marketplace connector setup

Pricing and brand positioning

Amazon’s role in future retail demand generation

We need someone who can understand the commercial impact of Amazon, not just the advertising dashboard.



Seller Central, Vendor Central & Hybrid Models

The ideal candidate should have strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central.

You should understand the practical differences between:

Selling directly to Amazon through Vendor Central

Selling through Seller Central

Using Seller Central for product testing and pricing control

Using Vendor Central for established products

Building a hybrid Amazon model

Transitioning products from Shopify testing to Seller Central and then Vendor Central

Using marketplace connectors to control listings, pricing and fulfilment

Experience with Shopify-to-Amazon workflows, marketplace connectors or multi-channel listing tools will be highly valued.



Product Listing & Marketplace Optimisation

You will review and improve Amazon product listings to support stronger conversion rates and better campaign performance.

This may include:

Product titles

Bullet points

Product descriptions

A+ Content

Amazon storefront structure

Product image recommendations

Keyword optimisation

Product positioning

Review and rating considerations

Listing consistency across marketplaces

Product catalogue troubleshooting

You should also be able to identify listing issues that may affect performance, including incorrect images, poor product data, weak product detail pages, incorrect brand links, duplicate listings, UPC/GTIN conflicts or storefront connection problems.



Brand Protection & Pricing Integrity

This role requires someone who understands the importance of brand control on Amazon.

You may need to help identify and resolve issues such as:

Amazon undercutting recommended pricing

Product ranges damaging brand positioning

Incorrect product information being pulled from other listings or marketplaces

Distributors or third parties affecting catalogue control

Products linking to the wrong storefront

Inconsistent pricing across Amazon, Shopify and retail

Poorly managed legacy SKUs affecting brand perception

You should be comfortable making practical recommendations about whether products should be retained, removed, repositioned, relisted or shifted between Seller Central and Vendor Central.



Product Testing & Campaign Scaling

A key part of this role is helping brands test Amazon as a growth channel before scaling investment.

You should be able to:

Recommend which SKUs to test first

Build a structured Amazon Ads testing plan

Allocate initial campaign budgets effectively

Track early performance clearly

Identify winning products and campaigns

Recommend when to scale spend

Explain when a product is not ready for advertising

Connect Amazon performance with broader eCommerce and retail goals

You should be comfortable working with initial test budgets and proving whether Amazon can become a scalable channel.



Reporting & Commercial Insights

You will prepare clear, practical reporting that helps clients understand performance and make better decisions.

Reporting may include:

Spend

Sales

ACOS

TACOS

ROAS

CPC

CTR

Conversion rate

Keyword performance

Search term performance

Product-level performance

Budget recommendations

Listing improvement recommendations

Next-step testing priorities

Reports should be simple enough for management teams to understand, while still detailed enough to support proper campaign optimisation.



Required Skills & Experience

The ideal candidate will have proven hands-on experience in:

Amazon Ads campaign management

Amazon Seller Central

Amazon Vendor Central

Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display

Amazon keyword research

Product targeting and competitor targeting

ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and conversion rate optimisation

Product listing optimisation

Amazon campaign reporting

Marketplace strategy for consumer products

Product launch or product testing campaigns

Amazon storefronts and A+ Content

Troubleshooting listing or catalogue issues

Working with multiple SKUs and product ranges

eCommerce performance marketing



Highly Valued Experience

Experience in any of the following would be a strong advantage:

FMCG, grocery, beverage, food, health, wellness, lifestyle or premium consumer products

Amazon Australia

Brands selling through both Amazon and Shopify

Marketplace connectors such as Codisto, Marketplace Connect or similar

Shopify and Amazon integration

Amazon Brand Registry

UPC, GTIN or catalogue ownership issues

Vendor Central pricing limitations

Seller Central pricing control

FBA, FBM and fulfilment workflows

Seasonal campaigns, product launches and promotional campaigns

Scaling Amazon campaigns from test budget to larger monthly spend

Using Amazon to support wider retail demand or product validation



Tools Experience

Experience with any of the following tools would be useful:

Amazon Ads Console

Seller Central

Vendor Central

Amazon Brand Registry

Amazon Brand Stores

Shopify

Marketplace Connect

Codisto

Helium 10

DataDive

Scale Insights

MerchantSpring

Jungle Scout

DataHawk

Pacvue

Perpetua

Google Analytics

Looker Studio

Meta Ads reporting

Google Ads reporting

ChatGPT or Gemini for research and reporting workflows



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

Amazon campaigns are structured properly and actively optimised

Ad spend is being used efficiently

ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and profitability are clearly managed

Product listings are improved before spend is scaled

Amazon becomes a stronger sales and testing channel

Seller Central, Vendor Central and Shopify are working together strategically

Pricing, listing and storefront issues are identified and addressed

Clients understand what is working, what is not, and what should happen next

The business is seen as a credible Amazon growth partner



Who This Role Suits

This role would suit someone who is:

A hands-on Amazon Ads specialist

Strong across Amazon marketplace operations

Commercially minded and return-focused

Comfortable advising on product and channel strategy

Strong with numbers, testing and reporting

Able to explain Amazon performance in plain English

Confident working across ads, listings, pricing and marketplace setup

Proactive in identifying issues and opportunities

Experienced with consumer product brands

Focused on profitable growth, not just traffic or impressions



Application Requirements

Please apply with your CV and a short summary of your Amazon experience.

In your application, please include:

Amazon marketplaces you have worked across

Product categories you have managed

Monthly ad budgets you have worked with

Examples of ROAS, ACOS, TACOS or sales improvements

Your experience with Seller Central

Your experience with Vendor Central

Any Shopify or marketplace connector experience

Examples of listing, catalogue, Brand Registry or pricing issues you have helped resolve

Experience with FMCG, beverage, grocery, food, wellness, health, lifestyle or premium consumer brands

Tools you are confident using



Suggested Job Title

Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist

Alternative titles:

Senior Amazon PPC Specialist

Amazon Marketplace Specialist

Amazon PPC & Seller Central Specialist

Amazon Growth Strategist

Amazon Performance Marketing Specialist

Amazon Seller Central & Vendor Central Specialist

Recommended title:

Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist

How to Apply



Please submit:



your CV / resume

a cover letter including:

your current employment status

your availability to start

why you want to join the team

why you believe you are a strong fit for this role

your experience with Australian surveying workflows or companies, if applicable

Before We Proceed



Before we potentially proceed to the interview stage, we’d like to gather a few details to make sure the role is a good fit and that you’ll be set up for success working remotely with our team.



1) PC / Laptop specifications + internet speed

Please share your device specs, including CPU, RAM, and storage, along with a recent internet speed test result. We need reliable performance and strong internet to support day-to-day work.



2) Current employment or side work (transparency request)

Are you currently employed or doing any side jobs or freelance work? We’re open to offshore tea
mbers having multiple jobs — what matters most to us is transparency, so we understand your typical schedule and can support you properly.



3) Hubstaff tracker

Are you comfortable using Hubstaff time tracking? Our whole team operates remotely, including our field and admin staff in Australia. Hubstaff helps us understand time allocation across projects, improve internal reporting, and provide clearer updates to clients.



4) Working hours / availability

Can you commit to the required hours? Our standard workdays are Monday to Friday, generally within 9:00am–5:00pm (Philippines time). We offer reasonable flexibility — family and life come first — but we do need consistency and clear communication.



5) Expected salary (PHP)

If this differs from what was listed in the advert, please confirm your expected salary in PHP.



6) CV / Resume

Please attach your CV if you haven’t already.



7) Relevant training / courses

Please include any relevant training certificates or courses you’ve completed.



8) English level

Please confirm your English level (C1/C2) and your confidence in both written and spoken English.



Team Context



For context, we currently have a team of 10 people in the Philippines, all working from home, and we’re continuing to grow. We value honesty, transparency, and teamwork. We’re looking for people who are humble, reliable, and easy to work with — because every role matters, and the most important thing is a happy team doing work they enjoy, surrounded by like-minded people.



Thanks, and we look forward to your reply.

Call, SMS, and
 new Meta Ads leads within 5 minutes of submission

-only experience does not qualify

title: Luxury Event Concierge Specialist
description:
We are a luxury event-planning company based in Los Angeles, specializing in premium picnics, proposals, birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers, tablescapes, and private celebrations.



We are looking for a reliable, polished, and highly detail-oriented Luxury Event Concierge Specialist to support client communication, lead follow-ups, reservations, payments, and event coordination.



This is a client-facing luxury concierge role, not a basic Virtual Assistant position. We need someone who can communicate professionally with US clients, guide leads through the booking process, handle pricing conversations, notice missing details, and take ownership without repeated reminders.



The right person is calm, organized, proactive, and comfortable helping clients move from first inquiry to confirmed booking.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with the opportunity to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Work Hours



Our main business hours are 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM PT / California time.



The exact schedule will be discussed during the hiring process, but we are looking for someone who can commit to a consistent part-time schedule of approximately 4 hours per day, 5 days per week.



What This Role Really Means



You will help protect the client experience from inquiry to event day.



You will be responsible for making sure leads are followed up with, clients receive clear answers, reservations are organized, payments are tracked, and missing details are noticed before they become problems.



This role requires someone who can think ahead, communicate clearly, and help keep the business organized every day.



Responsibilities

- Respond to client inquiries by
, phone, text, and messages

- Handle client calls professionally and confidently

- Follow up with leads and help convert inquiries into bookings

- Guide clients through packages, pricing, availability, and booking steps

- Handle pricing questions and objections in a polished, professional way

- Add new reservations and update client records

- Track payments, balances, event details, and client notes

- Review upcoming events for missing details, timing issues, or unclear requests

- Prepare client messages, summaries, and internal updates

- Support event planners with organized reservation information

- Help create and update event checklists when needed

- Use tools such as Gmail, Google Sheets, Asana, Stripe, and ChatGPT

- Escalate urgent or unclear situations before they become problems

- Help maintain a luxury-level client experience from inquiry to event day



Must-Have Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confident speaking with US clients by phone

- Experience in customer success, sales, hospitality, events, weddings, travel, concierge service, or premium customer service

- Strong follow-up skills and comfort helping turn inquiries into bookings

- Ability to handle pricing questions professionally

- Very strong attention to detail with dates, times, payments, client requests, and event notes

- Reliable, proactive, and able to complete work without repeated reminders

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, admin work, and structured processes

- Fast internet, quiet workspace, and professional communication style

- Backup plan for internet or power issues, such as hotspot, mobile access, or another reliable work location

- Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT to improve drafts, summaries, and templates



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has experience supporting premium clients and understands that tone, timing, accuracy, and follow-up matter.



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Can write polished and natural client messages

- Are comfortable with both sales follow-up and client support

- Can organize details without constant supervision

- Notice missing information before it creates a problem

- Know when to answer directly and when to escalate

- Stay calm and professional under pressure

- Want a long-term role with growth potential



Please Do Not Apply If

- You are looking for a basic VA/admin role only

- You are not comfortable speaking with clients by phone

- You need repeated reminders to complete tasks

- You are not detail-oriented with dates, times, payments, and client requests

- You are uncomfortable with sales follow-ups or pricing conversations

- You prefer step-by-step instructions for every small task

- You do not have reliable internet or a backup plan for remote work issues



Compensation

Starting at $6–$8/hour, depending on experience, phone confidence, sales ability, and relevant background.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Performance bonuses and pay increases may be available after the probation period based on reliability, client communication, lead follow-up, booking support, attention to detail, and overall ownership.



We are looking for someone who can prove strong communication, judgment, reliability, and attention to detail before moving into a long-term role.



To Apply



Please answer all questions below. Applications without complete answers will not be reviewed.



1. What experience do you have with luxury clients, events, hospitality, weddings, travel, concierge service, sales, or premium customer service?

2. Describe a time when you helped close a client, saved a client relationship, or handled a difficult customer professionally.

3. Have you handled phone calls with US clients? Please describe the type of calls and your comfort level.

4. A client says: “Your picnic is too expensive. Other companies are cheaper.” Write your professional reply.

5. A client asks for a proposal picnic quote but does not respond after receiving pricing. Write your follow-up message.

6. You are reviewing tomorrow’s events and notice that one client has not paid the remaining balance and the final location is not confirmed. What would you do?

7. Your power or internet goes out during your shift. What is your backup plan and how would you notify the team?

8. Are you available during 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM California time? Please share your preferred schedule and confirm if you are open to Tuesday–Saturday availability.

9. In the first line of your application, write: “I understand this is a client-facing luxury event concierge role.”



Please attach your most recent resume/CV. Thank you.

title: Video Editor
description:
Meta Ads Video Editor Wanted – E-Commerce | Long-Term Role

We run e-commerce brands across 4 international markets and we're scaling our paid social aggressively. We're looking for a high-output video editor to start with 2 of our markets — with a clear path to expand to all 4 markets (and higher pay) once you've proven your speed and quality.



Weekly Output Breakdown (Phase 1):



- 30–40 ads per week per market

- 2 markets to start

- Total: 60–80 ads per week (~260–340 ads/month)



Speed, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of what makes ads convert matter more than fancy VFX. This is a performance creative role, not a cinematic one.



The Opportunity



- Phase 1 (months 1–2): 30–40 ads/week per market × 2 markets = 60–80 ads/week total

- Phase 2 (month 3+): If you're crushing it, we expand to all 4 markets = 120–160 ads/week total with a meaningful pay raise

- Long-term: A stable, well-paid seat on a growing team — not a one-off gig



What You'll Be Doing



- Editing 30–40 Meta ads per week per market (60–80 ads/week total across 2 markets)

- Producing the same ad concept in 2 languages

- Swapping text overlays, captions, subtitles, and voiceovers for each language version

- Producing multiple variations per concept (different hooks, CTAs, intros, durations)

- Cutting UGC footage, stock clips, product shots, and screen recordings into scroll-stopping ads

- Formats: 9:16 (Reels/Stories), 1:1 (Feed), 4:5

- Adding captions, B-roll, text overlays, sound effects, music, and pattern interrupts

- Editing in the style of proven ad frameworks: Problem/Solution, Testimonial, Listicle, Before/After, Founder Story, Unboxing, "Did You Know", etc.

- Building reusable templates for efficient localization

- Organizing files by market/language so we can track performance per region

- Iterating fast based on ad performance feedback



Must-Haves



- 2+ years editing Meta/Facebook ads specifically (not just YouTube or weddings — paid social is its own craft)

- Proficient in at least one of: DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro

- Proven capacity to deliver 30–40 high-quality ads/week per market consistently

- Experience producing ads in multiple languages — you understand how text timing, line breaks, and subtitle pacing change when text length differs between languages

- Comfortable working with provided translations and voiceover files (we supply them — you don't need to speak the languages)

- Master of template-based workflows — you don't rebuild from scratch for every language version

- Extreme attention to detail with foreign-language text — no typos, no cut-off captions, no mismatched timing, even in languages you don't speak

- Deep understanding of the first 3 seconds — you know a weak hook when you see one

- Good English (written communication with our team)

- Reliable internet and a computer that handles HD editing smoothly



What We Offer



- Competitive monthly salary for Phase 1 (60–80 ads/week, 2 markets)

- Clear raise if/when we expand you to all 4 markets (120–160 ads/week)

- Performance reviews and raises every 6 months

- A clear brief for every ad with all assets (footage, translations, voiceovers) organized and ready

- Long-term, stable work — we're scaling, not testing the waters



How to Apply

To prove you actually read this (most applicants don't), please do the following:



1. Start your application with the word "Scroll-Stop" — applications without this will be ignored.

2. Send 3–5 examples of Meta ads you personally edited (Drive, YouTube, or Meta Ads Library links).

3. Have you produced ads in multiple languages before? If yes, which languages and how did you handle the workflow?

4. Be honest: can you realistically deliver 30–40 high-quality ads/week per market (60–80 total across 2 markets)? If your max is lower, tell me your actual sustainable number.

5. Tell me in 2–3 sentences: what makes a Meta ad hook work in the first 3 seconds?

6. Share your monthly rate and your main editing software.

7. Bonus: link to one e-commerce brand whose Meta ads you admire — and why.



Top candidates will get a paid test project (1 concept localized into 2 languages) within a week. The right person gets a long-term home with us.

title: Performance Video Ad Editor for Ecommerce Brand | AI UGC, Meta Ads, B-Roll, Short-Form Ads
description:
We are looking for a talented video ad editor to join our ecommerce brand team long term.



This is not a basic editing role.



We need someone who understands how to create scroll-stopping video ads for
, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. You should know how to turn raw clips, AI-generated footage, UGC videos, voiceovers, product clips, and b-roll into clean, high-converting ads.



Our brand sells consumer products online, and most of the videos we create are short-form direct response ads. Some videos will look like native UGC. Some will be voiceover with b-roll. Some will use AI UGC created with tools like Seedance 2.0. Some will be clean product-focused ads with captions, hooks, transitions, sound design, and strong pacing.



We are looking for someone creative, reliable, detail-oriented, and able to follow briefs carefully.



You do not need to be a professional media buyer, but you must understand that the goal of every video is not just to look good. The goal is to stop the scroll, hold attention, and make people want to buy.



What You Will Do



You will help us create different types of ecommerce video ads, including:



UGC-style ads from raw footage

AI UGC videos using Seedance 2.0 or similar AI video tools

Voiceover ads with clean b-roll editing

Product demo videos

Problem-solution ads

Testimonial-style ads

Hook variations for Meta and TikTok

Short 6 to 15 second ad variations

Longer 30 to 60 second direct response ads

Fast-paced ad edits with captions, zooms, cuts, overlays, and sound effects

Clean branded edits that match our brand style

Multiple variations for A/B testing



You will also be expected to:



Follow detailed creative briefs

Make revisions based on feedback

Organize files properly

Deliver edits on time

Suggest improvements when you see a better way to make the ad stronger

Understand why some ads perform better than others

Required Skills



You must have experience with:



Editing short-form video ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, DTC brands, or online products

CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or a similar editing tool

Strong pacing for social media ads

Clean captions and text overlays

Hook editing in the first 1 to 3 seconds

B-roll selection and sequencing

AI voiceovers, preferably ElevenLabs or similar tools

Editing for Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reels, and Shorts

Following brand guidelines

Taking feedback and making revisions quickly

AI Video Skills



This is very important.



We are also looking for someone who can help create AI video ads using tools like:



Seedance 2.0

Kling

Runway

HeyGen

ElevenLabs

ChatGPT

CapCut AI tools

Other AI video or voice tools



You do not need to be perfect with every tool, but you must be willing to learn fast.



A big part of this role may include creating AI UGC clips, AI voiceover videos, product b-roll scenes, and clean ad edits from AI-generated footage.



What We Are NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if:



You only know how to add subtitles

You only make basic TikTok edits

You cannot follow detailed instructions

You get upset when asked for revisions

You do not understand ecommerce ads

You cannot meet deadlines

You need someone to tell you every tiny step

You do not have examples of ad-style videos



We are not looking for a basic editor.



We are looking for someone who can become part of our creative team and help us create ads that actually sell.



Bonus Skills



Big bonus if you have experience with:



Ecommerce brands

Meta ads

TikTok ads

Direct response ads

UGC editing

AI video generation

Product ads

Canva

Photoshop

Figma

Motion graphics

Thumbnails

Static ad creatives

Creative strategy

Writing hooks or improving scripts

Work Schedule



This is a remote role.



We prefer someone who can work at least 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday.



You should be available for communication and revisions during agreed working hours.



We are looking for someone long term. If the work is good, this can become a stable monthly role.



Pay



Starting pay depends on skill level and experience.



Please include your expected hourly rate and monthly salary expectation in your application.



We are willing to pay more for someone who is genuinely good at video ads, follows briefs well, and can consistently deliver strong edits.



How To Apply



Reply with this exact subject line:



Performance Video Editor – Ecommerce Ads – YOUR NAME



In your application, send:



Your portfolio with 3 to 5 short video ads you edited

Your best ecommerce or UGC-style ad example

A short Loom video introducing yourself and explaining how you edit ads

The editing tools you use

Your experience with AI video tools like Seedance 2.0, Kling, Runway, HeyGen, or ElevenLabs

Your expected hourly rate

Your availability and working hours

Your internet speed and computer specs



We are hiring soon. Only apply if you are serious, reliable, and want a long-term role.

title: $6 Customer Service Representative
description:
ATTENTION CANDIDATES: READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING

We recently cut ties with our old third-party BPO partner. We tried to hire those agents directly, but their old BPO contracts blocked them. Now, those disgruntled agents are upset that new hires are taking over their positions. The old BPO is orchestrating "trick calls" and trying to weaponize old, dramatic articles on KSL or Reddit to scare new applicants and spread rumors that we are a scam.



Here is the truth: We have been in business a long time, we have a massive customer base, and we pay our people via verified direct deposit. We are hiring quickly right now simply because we need a lot of staff to handle our actual customers. Just because our hiring process is fast and efficient does not mean it's a scam. If you are qualified, we choose to trust you immediately. Do not join our team if you intend to log into our systems to start or read into drama. We are looking for professional people who want to work with integrity. If that is you, read the technical requirements below and apply.



$6/hr Customer Service Representative

Please login or register as jobseeker to apply for this job.



TYPE OF WORK: Full Time



WAGE / SALARY: $6 per hour (Traditional Direct Deposit to a verifiable bank account only. No Wisely, PayPal, WhatsApp transfers, or third-party money apps).



HOURS PER WEEK: 40



DATE UPDATED: May 15, 2026



JOB OVERVIEW

SEND ME A DIRECT MESSAGE, NOT YOUR AI GENERATED COVER LETTER OPEN HOUSE INTERVIEWS AT 5PM MST TODAY



We’re looking for sharp, empathetic, and quick-thinking Customer Service Representatives to join our Philippine-based remote team. This isn’t a "read from the script" kind of job. You’ll be managing real travel emergencies, helping members maximize their vacations, and earning extra cash through our aggressive performance incentive program.



Note: Onboarding and basic system walkthrough training takes approximately 90 minutes, and yes—you get paid for your training hours!



What You’ll Actually Do:

Be the Travel Hero: Handle inbound calls from international travelers. One minute you’re booking a luxury stay in Orlando, the next you’re investigating complex situations like "DNS" (Do Not Service) tags from old chargebacks, date changes, or manual payment collections.



Manage the Experience: Help members with their Vacation Offer accounts, unlock blocked logins, explain billing (like annual fees), and coordinate "Bouncebacks" (booking remaining stays for members who finished tour presentations).



Earn Extra Surcharges & Incentives: You are not selling new packages; you are booking what they already bought. However, you can easily pull in an extra $5.00 per action by securing hotel/room upgrades through the system, sending out 5-Star Feedback Surveys that mention your name, or generating new verified referral accounts.



What You Need to Bring (Non-Negotiable Technical Prerequisites):

Hardware: A reliable Windows 10+ PC or Laptop. (No Macs, Chromebooks, or Tablets allowed).



Peripherals: A high-quality, noise-canceling USB headset.



Internet Connection: Wired Fiber internet (25 Mbps+). Stability is key when on a live call.



Power Redundancy: A power backup (UPS) and a secondary internet source to work through local outages.



The Vibe & Mindset: Excellent English with a neutral accent. You must be thick-skinned. Our customers can be aggressive and demanding; you must meet their energy with confidence, authority, and control. We do not do call escalations or transfers—you will be fully equipped to resolve the call yourself.



The Schedule: You must be 100% okay with graveyard shifts, weekends, and PH holidays. Our entire network operates strictly on Mountain Daylight Time (MDT).



Software & Tools You Will Master:

description:

Continued placement depends on accuracy, professionalism, booking success, reliable attendance, no missed calls during scheduled shifts, quick response times, and the ability to professionally manage complaints and de-escalate dissatisfied clients.

(1) Location & Utilities: Where in the Philippines are you currently located? How often have you experienced power or internet outages in the past year? Do you have backup solutions (e.g., generator, mobile hotspot) to ensure your work is not affected?



(2) Home Setup: Will you be working from home? Is your workspace quiet and suitable for handling calls? Do you have your own computer or laptop? Please attach a screenshot of your current internet speed.



(3) Availability & Speed: Can you consistently work seven days a week, six hours per day, and remain available for the full shift without missed calls? How quickly do you typically answer inbound calls? What is your current typing speed in words per minute?



(4) Call & Complaint Experience: Describe your experience with answering inbound calls, booking or scheduling appointments, customer service, following scripts, and handling complaints. Provide one real example of how you de-escalated an upset client and the outcome.

Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund. Your tone should be calm, polite, and professional.



(7) Current Job: Do you currently have another job? If yes, where, how many hours per week, and what are your roles and tasks in that job?



(8) Schedule, Pay & Start Date: Are you able to work seven days a week, six hours per day, during Central Standard Time (CST) hours without conflicts? What is your expected hourly or monthly rate? What is your earliest physical start date if hired?



(9) Marketing, Design & Video: Do you have experience with online marketing, creating content using Canva, or producing short video clips such as
 Reels or similar platforms? Please describe your skills and provide samples of your previous work if available.



(10) Fit, Skills & Experience: Briefly introduce yourself and explain why you would be a good fit for this role. Include what you believe is most important when handling spa clients over the phone, especially during complaints, and what other skills or areas you have a lot of experience in.

title: Instagram Reels Editor — Wedding Photography & Videography Studio
description:
We're a wedding photography and videography studio based in Vancouver, BC looking for a creative video editor to help us produce Instagram Reels from raw iPhone footage. 



What the job looks like



You'll be given raw footage — iPhone clips, behind-the-scenes 
nts, wedding highlights, or talking-to-camera videos — and your job is to turn them into clean, engaging 15–60 second Instagram Reels that are ready to post. We have a consistent flow of content, so there's plenty of ongoing work.



We're not looking for color grading or advanced post-production. We're looking for someone who understands pacing, social media content, storytelling, and and the nuances and unique aspects of editting for social media to create engaging clips. I’m looking for someone who knows how to add text on screen, use trending audio, and apply different audio effects to add depth and texture to a clip to make it more interesting and feel more polished. 



One major part of your job will be to create a story out of a series of clips that were given to you. Often times, these clips are shot throughout the day or throughout a project, and it's your job to cut and edit them into a cohesive storyline. 



What we're looking for



Comfortable working in CapCut or other professional/ semi-professional editting software

Strong eye for pacing, visual flow, and storytelling

Experience editing wedding or lifestyle content for Instagram, ideally in the North American or Australian market

Someone who has enough digital storage on their device or SSD to handle multiple projects at once

Can produce clean, aesthetic results with minimal direction

Detail-oriented without needing hand-holding



What we're not looking for

Someone who produces generic-looking Instagram videos that could belong to any account. We're not looking for cheesy transitions, immature edits, or content that feels templated. And we're not looking for heavy color grading, complex motion graphics, or advanced post-production. This role is about speed, consistency, subtle addittions and simplicity, refined aesthetics, and good taste — the editing should feel invisible, not showy. We don’t need help managing our social media or designing a content plan. We’re looking for someone to take our raw footage and turn it into social media posts. 



Pay



$7 CAD per completed Reel. Some will take a few minutes, some a little longer — the rate is fixed regardless.

We'll start with a paid working interview where we'll walk you through our expectations and have you complete a test Reel so we can see how you work.

title: Automation-First Bookkeeper | Build a Multi-Platform System That Scales
description:
THIS IS NOT A STANDARD BOOKKEEPING ROLE.



We're building a fully automated, scalable accounting system from scratch for a multi-brand reputation management operation. We need someone who takes ownership, thinks proactively, and builds systems that run themselves.



We operate across Canada and the US, helping businesses protect and manage their online presence. We're scaling fast, expanding service lines, adding new payment processors, and migrating to additional brand entities in the coming months. Our financial infrastructure has to match. The person we hire won't just maintain records, they'll architect a system that gives us full financial clarity across every revenue stream, expense, and profit metric, automatically.



If you're a bookkeeper who is also strong with automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Dext, Hubdoc, or equivalent) and you've built multi-platform systems before, read on.



WHAT THE SYSTEM NEEDS TO DO



- Dual revenue tracking: accrual (deals closed) AND cash (payments collected) visible simultaneously with AR aging

- Deal-level gross profit tracking: client revenue minus exact contractor cost for that same deal

- Split payment logic from day one: client pays $5,000 deal in 4 installments = 1 revenue event. Contractor paid in 3 payments for 1 job = 1 expense event

- Anti-duplication controls: platform-to-bank transfers must never be counted as revenue

- Multi-platform integration: Stripe, Interac e-Transfer, Wise, PayPal, crypto (Koinly/CoinTracker), credit and debit cards, plus future payment-link processors like Venn, Massive, Payment Cloud

- Multi-brand and multi-service-category support: per-deal pricing ranges from $150 to $5,000 USD depending on service type, with new service types and brands added regularly

- Automated expense capture: screenshot to system and bookkeeper simultaneously

- Rules-based auto-categorization for all recurring charges

- Automated 2-day snapshots, weekly summaries, bi-weekly efficiency analysis delivered without me requesting them

- Live dashboard: revenue sold vs. collected, gross profit, net profit, expenses by category, outstanding receivables



CRITICAL DESIGN REQUIREMENT



The system must be configurable, not custom. Adding a new payment processor, service category, contractor role, expense type, or brand must be a configuration change, not a rebuild. This is non-negotiable and is part of the base scope of the Setup Phase, not a change order.



THE SCOPE



Phase 1: Setup (7 days, fixed price). Full system built and confirmed working. 12+ specific deliverables including dashboard, SOP document, walkthrough video, configuration guide, and confirmed test transactions running end-to-end. Detailed brief shared with shortlisted applicants.



Phase 2: Ongoing ($500 USD/month). Monthly reconciliation, all reports delivered, workflow monitoring, proactive flags. Payment released after monthly deliverables confirmed. The monthly retainer covers all configurable additions, no extras invoiced.



WHO THIS IS FOR



You've built automated bookkeeping systems, not just managed accounts.

You're fluent in QBO, Xero, Wave, or similar and can tell me which is best for this build and why.

You know Zapier, Make, n8n, Dext, Hubdoc, or equivalent.

You're proactive. You chase missing info. You flag issues before I notice them.

You respond fast and communicate clearly.



This is NOT for generalist bookkeepers who only handle manual entry.

This is NOT for someone who needs to be told what to do at every step.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE THREE QUESTIONS



Generic proposals will not be considered.



1. What accounting software would you recommend for this build and why?

2. A client pays a $3,500 deal across 3 installments over 2 weeks. Walk me through exactly how that appears in the system, accrual side and cash side.

3. If I add a new payment processor 4 months after the system is live, what does your process look like and how long does it take?



A full system brief is shared with shortlisted applicants.



Let's build something that runs itself.
